brand_notes.fabric: brands.json's brand-level fabric string is 'Cordura / X50 nylon (matte woven, splatter-dye prints)'. The maker's own SPECS tabs (read via a real Chrome session — wizard.works sits behind a Cloudflare JS challenge that 403s curl and WebFetch; the challenge auto-clears in ~7s in an actual browser tab) consistently list '500D Cordura Nylon Outer' in Black/Olive/Tan and '1000D Cordura Polyester Outer' in the Splatter colourway, with a 210D nylon liner. That confirms the Cordura half of the brand string across every product checked so far. No product page mentions 'X50' by name — that may be a liner or reinforcement fabric not called out on the consumer-facing SPECS tab, or a holdover from an older material. Verdict: Cordura is confirmed verbatim per-product; X50 is unconfirmed (neither contradicted nor found) and should be treated as unverified rather than wrong.
brand_notes.method: No usable local photos exist in assets/products/wizard-works/ (only two unrelated placeholder images, t2.jpg and test1.jpg, for 27 products) — see HANDOVER.md. Every record below is built from the maker's own product page (DESCRIPTION + SPECS + FEATURES tabs), fetched in a live Chrome tab (mcp__claude-in-chrome__navigate + get_page_text) after the Cloudflare challenge clears. Plain curl and WebFetch both 403. Geometry/hardware fields are therefore page-derived text evidence, not photo-verified, and are marked accordingly in confidence/dims_note. Dimensions quoted in each product's SPECS table are maker-published figures (verified: true); anything inferred beyond the literal page text is flagged low/medium confidence.

geometry.notes: Full-triangle frame bag, same general family as Forres, cut to the customer's own frame. No fixed shape beyond that — no photo, no generic dimensions.

closure.hardware: roll-top opening, seam-taped waterproof liner

details.fabric: customer's choice of outer fabric (Cordura per the standard range); 210D orange nylon liner
details.notes: 'All Custom Fit Roll Top Frame Bags Include': elastic-lacing on the top tube, a Hypalon lash tab with removable omni-tape strap on the head tube, replaceable omni-tape fastenings on the down/seat tubes, two webbing straps with metal G-hook closure, and foam padding against all tubes.

mount.notes: Bespoke fit to the customer's own frame triangle; geometry above is generic/indicative only, not a real product size. Clearance not established — no photo.

products.name: Custom Fit Zip Frame Bag
products.dims_raw: SPECS tab: 'Volume: Varies', 'Size: 5 or 6cm width options', 'Weight: Varies'. Size selector offers Partial / Full - Single Zip / Full - Double Zip, each made to the customer's own frame measurements.
products.dims_note: Same bespoke situation as the Custom Fit Roll-Top: no fixed length/height published, only a 5cm-or-6cm width choice. dims_cm intentionally omitted rather than guessed.

geometry.notes: Same family as Forres (full) or Osyth (partial) depending on the size option chosen, cut to the customer's own frame. No fixed shape beyond that — no photo, no generic dimensions.

closure.hardware: chunky #8 RiRi zip(s) on the drive side; double-zip option adds a removable floor between the zips for two compartments

details.fabric: customer's choice of outer fabric (Cordura per the standard range); fully lined
details.notes: 'All Custom Fit Zip Full Frame Bags Include': hydration/cable port, pump/tent-pole straps inside under the top tube, elastic-lacing on the top and seat tubes, Hypalon lash tabs with removable omni-tape straps on the down/head tubes, foam padding against all tubes. Optional extras: non-drive-side zip pocket, internal mesh pockets, a vertical divider (single-zip only).

mount.notes: Bespoke fit to the customer's own frame triangle, or a partial (under-top-tube-only) fit on the 'Partial' size option. Geometry above is generic/indicative only. Clearance not established — no photo.
